basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokemon Go player based in Seattle, WA, who enjoys connecting with fellow trainers for raids and events. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and in my free time, I love exploring the outdoors and participating in community activities. I'm passionate about sustainability and often engage in discussions about eco-friendly living. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. Currently single and enjoys attending live music events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in graphic design, having studied visual arts in college and worked in the industry for over 5 years. My knowledge extends to digital illustration, branding, and UX/UI design. I am also self-taught in photography, which I use to capture moments during my outdoor adventures.
